title: Custom Software Engineering Lead
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineering Lead  

**Project Role Description :** Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  

**Must have skills :** React Native  

**Good to have skills :** React.js  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

We are seeking an experienced software engineering professional to fulfill a technical engineering role. This position will contribute to and drive technical innovation, partner with cross\-team peers, influence and contribute to solution design and software delivery in a multi\-cloud environment.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

Develop and deliver high\-quality, customer\-facing user interface features within product teams using modern front\-end technologies  

Translate product requirements, UX designs, and technical specifications into performant, scalable, and maintainable UI components  

Build and maintain micro\-frontend\-based UI implementations aligned to product architecture  

Ensure all UI features adhere to accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and deliver consistent, usable experiences  

Implement well\-structured, testable, and efficient code using TypeScript  

Own UI quality by developing and maintaining unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests  

Integrate UI components with backend services via REST APIs  

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers to refine requirements and provide feedback on feasibility, usability, and technical approach  

Participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to iterative, predictable product delivery  

Conduct and participate in code reviews, enforcing best practices and improving overall code quality  

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve UI defects across development, testing, and production environments  

Contribute to build, deployment, and release processes through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub\-based workflows  

Identify and drive improvements in engineering practices, tooling, and team processes  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

  

Strong proficiency in TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI development  

Advanced experience with React, including hooks and modern state management patterns  

Ability to translate design systems and UX artifacts into high\-quality, production\-ready UI implementations  

Strong understanding of UI fundamentals including layout, typography, visual hierarchy, and responsive design  

Experience implementing accessible UI components aligned to WCAG standards  

Proven ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code  

Experience with unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing (e.g., Cypress)  

Strong commitment to code quality, testability, and automation  

Experience integrating with RESTful APIs  

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitHub Actions  

Understanding of performance optimization and web application security best practices  

Experience working within agile product teams and participating in Scrum ceremonies  

Ability to review and provide feedback on product requirements, technical designs, and UX specifications  

Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering, product, and design  

  

Educational Information:  

B.S. in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or equivalent education and experience  

Eight (8\) plus years of experience in application development  

Or equivalent combination of education and/or experience  

  

Additional Information:
  

  

You will be working with a Trusted Tax Technology Leader, committed to delivering reliable and innovative solutions


  

15 years full time education

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

This position designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life. Responsible for the full product lifecycle management, with a technical focus, including strategy, design, development, management, and end of life of new, existing or acquisition products. Leverage market insights to understand market/customer needs as well as emerging technology developments and trends to identify new opportunities or make adjustments to current product offerings. Balances deep subject matter expertise in the product, business use cases and solid technical aptitude. Accountable for delivering product performance against expectations and updates changes to a product portfolio to improve competitive position, and optimal product performance to meet customer and market needs. Accountable to and/or own the P\&L. Responsible for cross\-functional stakeholder management to include but not limited to design, engineering, scrum teams, business leaders, etc., functioning as technical expert with a fluency in development concepts and modern development practices. Positions in this function may require a background or degree in computer science or engineering.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provides explanations and interpretations within area of expertise
* Functions as dedicated Technical Product Owner (TPO) on 2 right sized, preferably co\-located agile development teams. Responsible for backlog prioritization and refinement according to direction from Strategic Product Management (SPM) and other TPM leads
* Be able to articulate detailed product overview, benefits, and associated personas
* Follows existing and defined requirements gathering and PI execution process while considering and suggesting improvement opportunities
* Participates and presents PI plans for teams in PI planning events
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 4\+ years of experience in product development or product management
* 2\+ years of product owner experience working on at least one agile scrum team
* Proficient understanding of the basics of the role of technical product management, agile practices/methodologies and the Software Development Life Cycle ((SDLC)
* Proficient level of experience in discovery, requirement definition and user story definition
* Proficient TPM assigned complex feature work on a single, primary product
* Proficient understanding of the role of technical product management, agile practices and the SDLC. Fluent with existing product tools for tracking and user story creation (Aha, Rally)
* Proficient level of experience in discovery, requirement definition and user story definition. With minimal guidance and oversight, can write quality stories, manage team and product dependencies and accept quality enhancements
* Proven excellent communication, organization and interpersonal skills

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Business, or a related field
* Certified scrum product owner
* Experience in product tools including Aha and Rally
* Experience with healthcare IT and/or knowledge of hospital revenue cycle

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior Manager - RGM
description:
Overview:  

ICC is a growing function within PepsiCo that leverages one strategy and common approach to introduce new, technology\-driven capabilities and elevate service quality while meeting current and future business needs. PEP RGM is a key priority function where transformation, technology, strategy and capabilities enablement are aimed to be the best in class, and to be standardized and deployed globally. The vision is to develop playbook to develop analytic packs with insights across Brand Ladders, Channel PPA, In\-Market Pack Price realization, Trade Investment Strategy, Promo ROI and Mix Management. This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.




This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. This position contributes to the success of the company and contribute to growth through strategy development, and implementation of RGM frameworks. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution

  


Responsibilities:  

Functional Responsibilities

* ICC RGM analyst will be responsible for conducting data analyses across all RGM levers \- Pricing, Promotion, Assortment Mix and Trade Investment
* Lead data aggregation and harmonization that will form the backbone of RGM analytics
* Collaborate with Market Cluster Leads to understand market dynamics and incorporate market feedback into analyses
* Bring out Next Gen Revenue Management insights by implementing advance analytics
* Integrate insights comprehensive summaries for RGM Tower Lead and RGM leader
* Improve understanding of pricing, promotions, pack architecture and trade investments through use of data analytic tools and visualization tools
* Improve processes of analyses and data management across category business units and marketing functions
* Develop observations/insights for each analysis in the RGM playbook and synthesize insights across analyses to create a storyline of opportunities
* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment
* Adavanced Analytics – Price Elasticity, Promotion Effectiveness and knowledge of Python, R, Tableau/Power Bi


Key Activities


* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market

  


Qualifications:  

* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science
* Prior experience in data analytics to derive data driven insights and consolidate them to generate recommendations
* Experience in developing data\-driven models for sales and marketing function
* Ability to handle multiple work streams simultaneously and to tight deadlines in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with stakeholders in North America, LATAM, APAC, or EMEA markets (preferred)
* Very strong analytical skills – excellent competency in MS Excel is a must, as is experience of managing complex, incomplete \& inconsistent datasets and defining strategic analytics (market sizing/growth forecasts etc).
* Experience in Tableau / Power Bi is preferred
* Proven experience using PowerPoint and ability to producing visually compelling presentations (i.e. beyond just operating the software) that are impactful with a senior audience
* Clarity in communication (English language) to enable production of a very high standard of commentary that is impactful and credible amongst our most senior audiences.
* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/Engg., Master’s degree is a plus
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan

title: Global Campaign Manager
description:
Overview:
**About JAGGAER**  

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products \- ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Role Summary:**  

The Global Nurture Campaigns Manager will own the execution, optimization, and governance of JAGGAER's marketing automation programs across Salesforce and Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement). This role will be responsible for building scalable campaign infrastructure, managing automated journeys, maintaining data quality, and ensuring marketing programs move prospects and customers through the funnel effectively.  

This role will partner closely with Demand Generation, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Content, Digital, and regional marketing teams to translate campaign strategy into technically sound, measurable programs. The position will manage campaign setup, segmentation, lead routing, scoring, nurture programs, email execution, testing, reporting, and ongoing platform optimization.  

The ideal candidate combines strong hands\-on Pardot and Salesforce expertise with campaign operations discipline, lifecycle marketing knowledge, analytical thinking, and the ability to improve processes at scale.
Principal Responsibilities:
**Marketing Automation Platform Ownership:*** Serve as a primary owner and power user of Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), ensuring the platform is configured, maintained, and used according to established marketing operations standards.
* Manage automation rules, engagement programs, dynamic lists, completion actions, scoring, grading, segmentation logic, suppression rules, and other core Pardot functionality.
* Maintain strong alignment between Pardot and Salesforce, including field mappings, campaign synchronization, lead and contact records, campaign membership, and activity visibility.
* Monitor platform health, sync errors, automation conflicts, data issues, and operational risks, resolving issues directly or coordinating with Sales Operations, IT, and external partners.

 **Campaign Management \& Execution*** Own the technical setup and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across email, webinars, events, paid media, content programs, and other demand generation channels.
* Build and manage Salesforce Campaigns and Pardot campaign assets, including emails, forms, landing pages, lists, automation rules, tracking links, and campaign member statuses.
* Establish repeatable campaign templates, naming conventions, QA checklists, and launch processes that improve speed, consistency, and reporting accuracy.
* Partner with campaign owners to translate campaign briefs into executable workflows, audience segments, routing logic, follow\-up actions, and measurement plans.
* Conduct pre\-launch and post\-launch QA for links, forms, personalization, segmentation, tracking, routing, suppression, rendering, and CRM synchronization.

 **Lifecycle Marketing \& Nurture Programs*** Support the lifecycle marketing strategy by building automated nurture journeys for prospects, leads, customers, and other key audiences.
* Develop and optimize Pardot Engagement Studio programs based on lifecycle stage, persona, product interest, engagement, buying signals, geography, and account characteristics.
* Partner with Demand Generation and Content teams to map content and messaging to stages of the buyer journey and create scalable always\-on nurture programs.
* Build re\-engagement, lead recycling, stalled\-opportunity, post\-event, customer engagement, and other lifecycle programs that improve progression and conversion.
* Continuously test cadence, subject lines, messaging, calls to action, segmentation, and journey logic to improve engagement and downstream pipeline impact.

 **Lead Management, Scoring \& Routing*** Manage and optimize lead scoring, grading, qualification, lifecycle stage progression, and handoff processes between Marketing and Sales.
* Support lead routing and assignment logic to ensure qualified prospects are delivered to the correct sales teams quickly and accurately.
* Monitor funnel movement and identify operational breakdowns between inquiry, qualification, nurture, MQL, sales acceptance, and opportunity stages.
* Partner with Sales Operations and Marketing Operations to improve lead status governance, campaign member statuses, attribution inputs, and CRM data consistency.

 **Data, Segmentation \& Personalization*** Build accurate audience segments using Salesforce and Pardot data, including demographic, firmographic, behavioral, campaign, account, and lifecycle attributes.
* Maintain suppression logic, consent requirements, subscription preferences, and data hygiene processes to improve deliverability and campaign quality.
* Use dynamic content, personalization, and segmentation to create more relevant experiences across lifecycle and demand generation programs.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, stale, or inconsistent records and work with operations partners to improve
  

database quality and governance.

 **Reporting, Measurement \& Optimization*** Track campaign and lifecycle performance including delivery, engagement, conversion, MQL creation, funnel progression, pipeline influence, and other agreed KPIs.
* Build and maintain campaign reporting within Salesforce and Pardot, and partner with Analytics teams on dashboards and attribution reporting.
* Analyze program performance to identify bottlenecks, underperforming segments, nurture opportunities, and areas for campaign optimization.
* Provide actionable recommendations to campaign owners and marketing leadership based on performance data and funnel behavior.

 **Marketing Operations \& Governance*** Maintain documentation for campaign processes, automation logic, naming conventions, field usage, scoring models, routing, and lifecycle workflows.
* Support user access, platform governance, testing, release management, and change control across Salesforce and Pardot marketing workflows.
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, IT, and vendors on integrations, troubleshooting, platform enhancements, and process improvements.
* Stay current on Salesforce and Pardot capabilities and recommend improvements that increase automation, efficiency, scalability, and data quality.


Position Requirements:
* 5\+ years of experience in marketing automation, marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, campaign operations, or a related B2B marketing role.
* Hands\-on experience administering and executing campaigns in Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, including Campaigns, Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, campaign member statuses, and reporting.
* Experience building automated nurture programs, segmentation, lead scoring, grading, routing, email campaigns, forms, and landing pages.
* Strong understanding of B2B demand generation funnels, lifecycle stages, lead management, and Marketing to\-Sales handoff processes.
* Experience with campaign QA, data hygiene, consent and suppression logic, email deliverability, and marketing database management.
* Ability to troubleshoot automation, sync, routing, segmentation, tracking, and campaign execution issues independently.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign and funnel performance and turn findings into operational improvements.
* Excellent project management and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to documentation, governance, and quality assurance.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience supporting marketing automation within a B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, procurement, or complex global organization.
* Salesforce or Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement certifications.
* Experience with advanced Salesforce reporting, campaign attribution, dashboards, and funnel analytics.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, webinar platforms, paid media integrations, ABM platforms, and other marketing technology tools.
* Experience with HTML/CSS for email and landing page troubleshooting or customization.
* Experience supporting global campaigns, multiple regions, languages, business units, or complex routing structures.
 **Success Measures:*** Campaigns launch accurately, on time, and with consistent tracking, routing, and Salesforce campaign structure.
* Lifecycle and nurture programs increase engagement, qualification, funnel progression, and pipeline contribution.
* Lead scoring, routing, and Marketing\-to\-Sales handoffs operate reliably with fewer errors and faster follow\-up.
* Salesforce and Pardot data remains clean, synchronized, well governed, and usable for segmentation and reporting.
* Marketing teams gain scalable processes, templates, documentation, and automation that reduce manual campaign work and improve execution speed.
 **What We Offer:**  

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family's well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a  

range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. **Our Values \- T.E.A.M:**  

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the  

teams behind them \- the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common  

set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.* **Transparency** \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures  

problems are solved together \- with customers, teammates, and partners.
* **Entrepreneurial Spirit** \- Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the  

cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth.
* **Accountability \-** Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere.
* **Metrics\-Driven Results** \- Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct  

quickly, and ensure we're delivering real impact.

**EEO:**  

JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate  

based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical  

conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender  

status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other  

applicable legally protected characteristics **Great Place to Work® Certified 2026 – JAGGAER**  

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and people come first.  

We are proud to announce that **JAGGAER has been certified as a Great Place to Work® for 2026**, recognizing our commitment to creating an inclusive, empowering, and high\-performing culture.

title: Digital Commerce - Commercial Senior Manager
description:
Overview:

The main purpose of the role is to enable US Digital Commerce Sales team of Walmart with timely insights, advanced analytics, data intelligence \& business recommendations. The role will work on a daily basis with mid level to Senior level Sales leaders in the org, be their go\-to person for all analytics and deep dive needs. The role will be responsible for digitizing Sales processes, building/ leveraging quick automation solutions/ tools and contribute effectively to the long term Tech needs of the Walmart team by collaborating on regular basis with the DTX team or other Product teams. The role will be responsible for driving efficiencies within current processes, identifying further opportunities, executing change and improving Customer satisfaction with the service we provide.

  



The role will need to deliver high quality channel analytics to deep dive on relevant business problems, solve through actionable insights and recommendations to business team, thereby influencing business decision making. Incumbent will be responsible to build compelling stories from the data \& showcase impactful presentations to Senior Leaders. The role will be accountable for accurate measurement \& reporting of important business KPIs. The role will function as Digital Commerce SME (subject matter expert) building sharp domain knowledge \& market intelligence in the long run. This will be an IC role (Individual Contributor).


Responsibilities:
* Be the go\-to person for US Walmart team to enable timely analysis, insight generation, actionable recommenations, opportunity analysis
* Leverage existing tools, create new scorecards or enhance existing ones, support dashboarding requirements as needed. Elevate scorecards with advanced analytics, including projections, automations \& potentially language learning models
* Advanced data fluency across disparate data sources, including Promotions data \& forecasting data
* Prepare monthly drivers \& drags, highlights, weekly emails, customer call\-outs \& perform advanced analytics
* Run weekly execution and summary of insights/drivers/trends – weekly Share report build outs, elevate reporting with AI custom\-built for the Walmart Sales team, saving the team time. Provide key highlights in the form of sales drivers and drags, Share change analysis, Share of Voice analysis \& other key business insights
* Collaborate with DTX / Tech team to build solutions/ tools \& further digitize Sales funnel through Machine Learning
* Lead with Sales team to influence functions like Finance, RGM, Walmart PCT, GTM \& Supply Chain teams
* WBR, MBR, QBR, AOP, JBP, Divisional decks, Customer meetings: remain actively engaged, deep dive \& prepare content with guidance from Sales Leads including trends, business performance, view on multiple metrics, insights \& Next Best Action plans
* Constantly adapting to channel shifts at WM and translating that to the workstreams (e.g. SFS/DFS, Node inStock)
* Build presentation for POR decks, dComm business updates (2\-3 pagers) \- internal \& customer\-facing
* Train the team in Luminate Training \& partner closely with Strategy lead to execute insights for LT requests
* Collaborate with multiple teams (Sector, Sales, Marketing, DTX, Strategy etc) to develop Digital Commerce Channel intelligence, identify \& understand channel nuances, monitor competition, benchmark basis omni channel performance
* Build showcases, great presentations, case studies, 1 pagers to communicate compelling stories through data \& insights
* Build strong stakeholder partnership and raise the bar on Customer experience/ satisfaction
* Act as coach/ guide in the Sales operations capability area, particularly within Walmart domain


Qualifications:
* 7\-8 years of experience in analytics and insights
* Strong delivery \& execution focused with sharp organizational skills
* Strong analytical \& deep dive skills, data driven, impact driven
* Great story telling skills, ability to generate actionable insights from the data and provide business recommendations
* Strong presentation skills, ability to build showcases \& share compelling stories through data
* Ability to collaborate efficiently across cross functional teams like Marketing, Tech, Insights, Finance, Supply Chain etc.
* Strong problem\-solving capabilities with a track record of finding feasible solutions to complex problems, especially in an ambiguous environment with tight timelines
* Sound communication skills – ability to collaborate, educate and influence internal and external teams \& peers
* Demonstrate resilience – maintain courage \& positive attitude when faced with obstacles; willingness to deploy alternative approaches to overcome them
* Demonstrate Bias for action \& high ownership, high velocity decision making capability \& maintain highest levels of rigor and compliance
* Proficient in analytical tools (Power BI, Tableau, Thoughtspot, Advanced Excel, MS\- Powerpoint, MS\-Office, Machine Learning, Gen AI, Python, R, Scintilla, Nova etc.)
* Strong in building relationship with stakeholders \& maintain high degree of Customer satisfaction
* Strong Digital Commerce domain knowledge, market nuances etc.
* Proven high quality delivery in the capacity of an Individual Contributor

title: Senior Technical Product Owner
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**


We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Owner** to drive the vision, roadmap, and delivery of key digital products, including FinOps and AI agent solutions. This role will own products end\-to\-end, ensuring they deliver measurable business value, drive adoption, and support WSA's digital transformation journey.

**What you will Own**
---------------------

* **FinOps.** Our FinOps products give engineering teams and finance a shared, trustworthy view of cloud spend across our providers and push cost accountability into the teams that create the cost. You own their vision, roadmap and backlog end to end.
* **Discovery for what comes next.** New products are taking shape in our cloud and platform strategy area. You will help develop them through product discovery, prototypes and stakeholder interviews, and give them a definition and a first roadmap. Who owns them in the end is decided later.
* **Possibly more.** Depending on the profile we find, smaller existing products can be added to your responsibilities – our Backstage developer portal, or our Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud offerings, for example.
* **Outcomes, not output.** You are measured on adoption across the applications on the platform and on the decisions that change because of your product, not on the number of stories closed. You present your roadmap and your results to leadership yourself.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Talk to the people who use our FinOps products – platform teams, application teams and finance – and turn what you learn into a roadmap they recognise as theirs.
* Write the user stories and acceptance criteria yourself. You know the difference between a story and a specification.
* Prioritise against business value, technical feasibility and the platform strategy, and defend the ranking when it is challenged.
* Work with the engineering team day to day: refinement, design reviews, demos and releases. You can read the code and the architecture, and you will.
* Track adoption and outcomes, and act on what the numbers tell you.
* Manage expectations and dependencies with stakeholders across WSA.
* Run product discovery and stakeholder interviews for new products in the strategy area

**What you bring**
------------------

* A technical background: 5\+ years in software engineering, architecture or platform engineering, and real responsibility for deciding what gets built – as a product owner, a tech lead or an architect.
* You have shipped something other teams depend on – an internal platform, a service, a tool – and lived with the consequences.
* You understand cloud platforms well enough to challenge an engineer's estimate and to spot when a cost report is wrong. Hands\-on FinOps experience is a plus; the practice can be learned, the instinct cannot.
* You have made a case to senior stakeholders, won some and lost some, and can explain what you would do differently.
* You can work with an empowered agile team without needing to run it. Scrum or SAFe familiarity is useful; process for its own sake is not.
* You are interested in LLM\- and agent\-based solutions and have a realistic view of what they can and cannot do today.
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable working in a multi\-region team across time zones..

**Who we are**
--------------


At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.


Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.


With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**


WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
**Overview**  

Lead the vision and execution for next\-generation agentic AI products—designing generative experiences across search, chat and other agentic experiences. As a **Principal Product Manager** for the Search \& AI team, you’ll architect solutions that reason, plan, and act across applications, the web, and the OS, empowering users to accomplish complex tasks with intelligence and reliability.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer - Security
description:
**Company Description**  

Axiado is building the future of AI powered digital infrastructure. We are a fast\-growing, well funded silicon, systems, and solutions company pioneering a new category of semiconductor called the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU) that combines advanced hardware security, AI driven resilience and efficiency, and real\-time platform management. Our technology protects the world’s most critical infrastructure—from data centers to next generation cloud and AI platforms—by securing systems at the foundation levels of hardware, independent of host CPUs and operating systems.


Founded in 2019 and now over 150 employees are strong, Axiado has evolved into a recognized leader in the convergence of AI, security, and silicon innovation. We partner with and are actively engaged in commercial programs with multiple Tier 1 industry leaders, validating both our technology and our long\-term market trajectory. Axiado has also won numerous industry awards for our ground\-breaking products and technological innovations, including being named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Security, winning the 2025 Global InfoSec Award for Outstanding AI Security Solution, and being named a finalist for the Global Semiconductor Alliance’s 2025 “Start\-Up to Watch” award.


At Axiado, developing breakthrough technology takes more than great engineering—it takes a team of exceptional people who collaborate boldly, challenge assumptions, and take pride in building what comes next. We value curiosity, execution, respect, and a shared desire to make a meaningful impact on the security and reliability of the digital world.


If you’re driven to innovate, energized by hard problems, and excited to help define the future of secure AI infrastructure, we invite you to apply and join us on this journey.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our System Manager team.


In this role, you will have an opportunity to work alongside a high\-performing engineering team on cutting\-edge technologies that enable secure root of trust functionality. You will contribute to the design, development, integration, and validation of low\-level platform firmware responsible for system management, secure boot, platform security, device management, and recovery functionality.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 6–10 years of experience in Embedded Firmware/Software development.
* **Strong proficiency in Embedded C, data structures, and low\-level programming**.
* **Strong hands\-on experience with any RTOS, with FreeRTOS experience preferred.**
* Good understanding of ARM\-based SoCs, multicore architecture.
* Experience developing/debugging low\-level drivers.
* **Strong system\-level debugging skills** using JTAG, logs, crash/exception analysis.
* **Familiar with Git**, code reviews, unit testing, static analysis, and CI/CD.
* Ability to independently own features from requirements and design through implementation, integration, validation, and release.
* **Strong communication skills** with the ability to collaborate with all other stake holders

  

**Additional Information**  

* Experience with SPDM, PLDM, MCTP protocols
* Experience with Caliptra, Crypto/security APIs
* Experience with bootloaders and platform firmware, including initialization, boot flows, reset handling, recovery, and firmware\-update mechanisms.
* Understanding of firmware authentication/signature verification, OTP provisioning

title: Sr Product Manager
description:
When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.


Job Description:


We are seeking a strategic, outcome\-driven Product Manager to lead the vision, execution, and growth of AccurateWatch, Accurate Backgrounds next\-generation continuous monitoring platform. This role will be responsible defining and delivering a centralized, self\-service monitoring experience that unifies monitoring programs across multiple risk domains, industries and customer segments.


As a Product Manager for AccurateWatch, you will drive the evolution of a market\-leading platform that helps organizations proactively identify workforce and compliance related risks through ongoing monitoring of driver records, professional licenses, sanctions, criminal and other post\-hire risk indicators. You will play a critical role in transforming traditionally fragmented monitoring solutions into a seamless, scalable platform experience that delivers actionable intelligence, operational efficiency, and enterprise grade solutions.


This role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking, customer\-centric discovery, product execution, go\-to\-market leadership, and cross\-functional influence. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys solving complex customer and regulatory problems, and has a proven track record of delivering enterprise grade service\-based products from concept through scale.


Accurate Background is a fast\-growing organization, focused on helping companies build trusted workforces through innovative background screening, monitoring, and workforce intelligence solutions. We continue to exceed by delivering industry\-leading technology, compliance expertise, and exceptional client experiences.


If you enjoy building category\-defining products, solving meaningful business problems, and creating measurable customer value, we’d love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for AccurateWatch continuous monitoring platform.
* Develop long\-term platform strategies that support business growth, market expansion, and customer retention objectives.
* Identify opportunities to expand platform capabilities, create competitive differentiation, and increase customer adoption and engagement.
* Translate strategic objectives into clearly defined product initiatives, epics, requirements and measurable outcomes, managing priorities and investment based on customer value, business impact, risk mitigation and strategy.
* Partner with Engineering, UX, Architecture and Data teams to deliver scalable, intuitive, and high\-performing platform capabilities.
* Act as a product ambassador across the organization, communicating vision, priorities, progress and outcomes to leadership.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing and Solutions to develop sales enablement and go to market efforts to unlock growth opportunities.
* Lead customer discovery activities including interviews, Voice of Customer sessions and jobs to be done research.
* Develop deep expertise in customer workflows, compliance requirements, industry regulations, and risk management practices.
* Conduct market analysis, competitive assessments, and industry trend evaluations to identify market opportunities and product investments.
* Partner with and build strong relationships with Sales, Customer Service, Compliance, Operations, and Account Management teams to capture customer feedback and emerging needs. Serve as the voice of the customer throughout the product lifecycle.
* Influence strategic decisions through data\-driven insights, business case development, and customer feedback.
* Drive alignment among stakeholders while balancing competing priorities and business objectives.

 **Required Qualifications:**

* Must have HR Technology experience
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of Product Management experience managing enterprise software, SaaS platforms, or technology solutions.
* Demonstrated experience leading products from discovery through launch and scale.
* Strong understanding of product management methodologies, Agile development, and roadmap planning.
* Experience conducting customer discovery, market research, competitive analysis, and product validation.
* Proven ability to translate customer needs into actionable product requirements and business outcomes.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Highly analytical with experience using data to inform prioritization and product decisions.
* Experience working in cross\-functional environments with Engineering, UX, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience in the background screening, workforce screening, compliance or continuous monitoring solutions.
* Experience building workflow, compliance, HR technology, workforce management or risk management products.
* Knowledge of regulated industries including transportation, healthcare, staffing, financial services, or enterprise workforce management.
* Experience developing self\-service platform experiences.
* Experience supporting Go\-To\-Market activities, product launches and sales enablement initiatives.
* Master’s Degree.
 **Working Conditions:**  

* Dynamic, fast paced, growth oriented environment.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and customer centered culture.
* Extended periods of computer based work.
* Up to 25% travel as needed to support customers and stakeholders

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $99,000 \- $145,000\. Pay will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and relevant education and training. This position may also be eligible for an annual performance\-based bonus, commission, or other variable pay plan. The Company also offers a full range of benefits, including medical, dental, and 401k. Your recruiter can share more details about the specific compensation package during the hiring process.

 **The Accurate Way:**


We offer a fun, fast\-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.

  



**Take ownership.**


Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.  



**Be open.**


Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.

 **Stay curious.**


Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.

 **Work as one.**


Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

 **Equal opportunities**


Accurate is an equal\-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  

Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

  

This posting is open for U.S.\-based candidates who currently reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, DE, FL, GA, IL, KY, MD, MI, MN, NV, NH, NY, NC, OH, OK, PA, TN, TX, VA, WA, WV

  



**Special Notice:**


Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.

* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in\-person format.

* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.
